title: A reception for Japanese envoys
translation: Kim Eung-gi, the Right State Councillor, was appointed to preside over a banquet at the Ministry of Rites for the Japanese envoys, including Nanko Seido.

notes.title: 南湖西堂
notes.text: The envoy’s designation is retained in the original. Nanko Seido is a provisional reading and should receive specialist verification before scholarly use.
